content:
maria: Quick sync — aiming for Tue Jul 14 2026 10:00am PT publish. We need one canonical changelog link, docs anchor, and the rollout cadence by EOD. Also webinar assets and inbound lead routing.

devon: Progressive rollout works: canary 09:40 PT (5%), 50% at 09:50, 100% by 10:00 if metrics stable. Ops will pause on p95 > 2x baseline or error-rate spikes.

anya: Docs PR is up: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/912 — includes migration notes and examples. Waiting on the short perf blurb from eng for the hero line.

maria: Marketing needs a single-sentence headline + one supporting stat for the post and email. Keep it punchy for social.

devon: Draft headline: "Batching + cache warmup cuts median gen latency ~26% and lowers per-1k token cost ~23%." Ill confirm exact measured values and drop them into the docs + changelog PR tonight.

maria: Webinar is Mon 9:00am PT. Need a 90s perf clip and one-slide summary for the email. Who records?

devon: Ill record a short terminal demo and the perf run, upload to the release drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/releases/media/clip-jul14.mp4.

salesops: CRM tag = "jul_release_2026". Please ensure webinar and site forms include this hidden field and POST to CRM. SLA: 48h for lead follow-up. Example webhook payload to send to salesops staging: 

```json
{"email":"lead@example.com","name":"Sam Lead","tags":["jul_release_2026"],"source":"release_banner"}
```

ops-bot: Release window created: 2026-07-14T16:40:00Z -> 2026-07-14T17:15:00Z (canary -> ramp). Runbook: /runbooks/releases/2026-07-14. Monitor channel: #release-watch.

maria: Perfect. Marketing will hold publish until changelog is merged, docs anchor is live, and ops posts green at 10:00 PT. Ping this thread when those three items are done :thumbsup:
